title: Prep the decision on what wakes marketing up
ask: Marketing is dormant by standing instruction and nothing anywhere says what would turn it back on, so it is off by inertia rather than by decision. Prep a decision card the CEO can rule on in a minute: two or three concrete triggers with a recommendation — a date, a public build, a number of players, whatever is actually checkable from here — and what each one would commit the studio to doing once it fires. Do not ask him an open question; give him options.
first_action: Read the dormancy record in hq/data/pillars.json and ITCH_PAGE.md, then write the card into hq/data/decisions/.
source_message: Marketing is dormant by standing instruction and nothing anywhere says what would turn it back on, so it is off by inertia rather than by decision. Prep a decision card the CEO can rule on in a minute: two or three concrete triggers with a recommendation — a date, a public build, a number of players, whatever is actually checkable from here — and what each one would commit the studio to doing once it fires. result: Prepared Q-120, “When should dedicated marketing start?”, for Daniel to choose. It offers three checkable triggers: the next public build upload (recommended, one gameplay clip and a 30-day readout), 100 itch.io downloads in seven days (a small campaign after account verification), or a dated fresh-player robot session (copy and press materials prepared for review). Each option says what the studio does and what still needs another decision. The earlier Q-89 draft was stale: Q-89 now belongs to the bug-report ruling, and v0.2.0 already shipped. Q-120 has no ruling. Marketing remains dormant; the wake_trigger field remains null.

recommend.question: When should dedicated marketing start?
recommend.answer: The next public update, with one measured announcement.
recommend.why: The studio can verify a public upload itself and test one accurate message without committing to a full campaign.
recommend.instead: Wait for 100 downloads in seven days; that requires account analytics and could leave marketing dormant indefinitely.
